declarations.description:
A web component for block and inline content warnings.

Based on the original concept: https://codepen.io/aarongustafson/pen/QWZpqPe

cssProperties.description: Amount of blur in blur mode.

slots.description: Default slot for the content that needs a warning

members.name: revealLabel
members.description: Authored whole-label override. Null/undefined assignment removes it. Nonempty plain text supporting only {type}; overrides legacy fragments and shared defaults. Updates in place before reveal.

members.name: typeLabel
members.description: Authored fallback for missing/empty type. Null/undefined assignment removes it. Overrides shared type-label and default content. Nonempty plain text.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Rereads page-level inline application/json data-content-warning-config and instance labels. Flat partial reveal-label/type-label object only; no named scopes or automatic language selection. Precedence: instance template, explicit legacy fragments, shared template, legacy defaults. Shared JSON is cached until its text changes; edits require refresh per instance. Updates text in place, preserving focus and reveal state. Returns false and logs errors for invalid configuration or disconnected/uninitialized calls; retains previous text, or legacy initial text on initialization failure. Returns true without changes after reveal.

members.name: render
members.description: Initializes shadow content once, or refreshes labels. Never conceals revealed content.

members.name: type
members.description: Space-separated list of warning types (e.g., "violence spoilers")

members.name: labelPrefix
members.description: The prefix text for the warning label (default: "Content Warning")
members.deprecated: Use revealLabel. Planned for removal in the next major release.

members.name: labelSuffix
members.description: The suffix text for the warning label (default: "Click to reveal"). Set to "false" to hide.
members.deprecated: Use revealLabel. Planned for removal in the next major release.

members.name: revealed
members.description: Whether the content has been revealed

events.name: content-warning:revealed
events.description: Fired once after reveal state/DOM updates and before the host focus attempt. Bubbles and is composed; not cancelable. Label changes and refresh do not emit it.

attributes.name: reveal-label
attributes.description: Nonempty complete visible/accessibility label template with optional {type} tokens. Own punctuation; takes precedence over deprecated fragments and page defaults.

attributes.name: type-label
attributes.description: Nonempty plain-text fallback for absent/empty type; default content, overridden by shared or instance configuration.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Space-separated list of warning types (e.g., "violence spoilers")

attributes.name: label-prefix
attributes.description: The prefix text for the warning label (default: "Content Warning")
attributes.deprecated: Use reveal-label. Planned for removal in the next major release.

attributes.name: label-suffix
attributes.description: The suffix text for the warning label (default: "Click to reveal"). Set to "false" to hide.
attributes.deprecated: Use reveal-label. Planned for removal in the next major release.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: Display the warning inline instead of as a block overlay

attributes.name: blur
attributes.description: Visually blur content behind the opaque warning button; not Reader Mode safe.

declarations.name: defineComponentName
declarations.description: Register the element when a browser registry exists; return false without one. Existing registrations are preserved.
